review.name: Surface feels unfinished and noisy
review.reviewBody: The surface feels very unfinished. When I slide my hand across it, it makes a lot of noise.  Interestingly, I returned the 47" because it was a wee bit small but the surface seemed polished on that one.

review.name: Table top
review.reviewBody: I got this to go with some other pieces so I could have a sturdy top for my computer equipment and it looks good. Overall satisfactory

review.name: Simple. Placed it on top of my 2 alex drawers and created a desk!
review.reviewBody: I have the older alex drawers so I can't screw the top onto the alex drawers. I decided to create a table for myself and this tabletop has been perfect for it. Simply place it on top. I actually cut to size and placed grippy drawer liners on the top of both of the alex drawers before placing the tabletop so it won't shift too easily. Once you have all the stuff on top of your table it weighs it down and it won't move. This is a great size and with alex drawers on both sides it still gives me a alot of room for my chair for sitting!

review.name: Okay unless you need to drill holes.
review.reviewBody:
This is a very poor tabletop. The material underneath isn’t good if you need to drill your own holes. It just crumbles when you screw in the screws. 

If you use the pre drilled holes, it will probably make do.

The Galant tabletop that was discontinued was a much stronger and more durable material. 


This feels much less substantial.

review.name: Table Top
review.reviewBody: Love it!

review.name: Fantastic Tabletop
review.reviewBody: I used this tabletop for my 3D printing station it is sturdy and clean with a great gray matt finish and wood side which look fantastic and are durable for all my printing projects. I love this product!

review.name: Perfect Tabletop
review.reviewBody: The tabletop was the perfect choice for my home office desk. I also purchased the adjustable legs. I'm so glad I did. My desk is at the perfect height for me.

review.name: Tabletop

review.name: poor condition

review.name: Made of Cardboard

review.name: Tabletop
review.reviewBody: I use the 2 tabletops together for my sewing room and they are perfect.  They give me enough room cut my patterns while leaving the space to maneuver around the table.

review.name: Fantastic piece
review.reviewBody: I absolutely love this piece.  It’s very sturdy, and love how it fits the Alex drawers.  All hardware was present.

review.name: Desk top

review.name: Weird surface
review.reviewBody: Putting anything on the surface leaves white scratch that wipes off.  Love IKEA but making the 2 hr drive to return this!

review.name: Perfect
review.reviewBody: Love the size of the desk, more than enough space for my new 24” all in one computer and printer. And the desk is thick enough for a clamp on desk lamp.

review.name: Great product
review.reviewBody: This tabletop used in conjunction with 2 Alix drawer units makes a great craft desk.

review.name: Sleek Look
review.reviewBody: We put two of these together, end to end, to create a sleek and unified workspace. In addition to two computers we are able to fit plenty of needed items. We are using the stationary legs.

review.name: It fit my budget
review.reviewBody: It fit my budget but it is not a bargain. I was careful handling the tabletop when fastening the legs and removed the plastic and protective cardboard when the desk was completely assembled.  Still there was a chip on one edge and a corner was bashed in. I suspect the damage happened on the way to being delivered to my house. The finish on the surface doesn't look durable and I wouldn't be surprised if it quickly starts to look worn. I feel I'm paying for the convenience of having a piece of furniture within days. The quality is just enough to make it a pain to return.  If time wasn't a factor, I would have shopped around for a second hand desk.

review.name: Table top
review.reviewBody: This table top comes in many sizes with different leg options to pick from. Some legs even adjust up or down. Assembly was easy.

review.name: It goes well with Alex drawer

review.name: I am very sad at how terrible the quality has become
review.reviewBody: I have purchased and built 12 Alex units with Casters over the past few years. I am absolutely horrified at how bad they are in my order delivered 9/30. The quality of the engineering is barely acceptable but the failure is when the change in the wood meets the engineering pieces don’t fit well so when they are pressured into the correct spot they literally begin falling apart. IKEA was obviously aware of the horrible wood quality they changed one of the fastening parts to plastic so that the materials have a better chance to stay intact. They also took me significantly longer to build because nothing fit together easily. Since I have so many already for my project I need to keep what I have. But I am really sad that the IKEA I have loved so much can no longer be my go to. I have pictures of how bad it is but there is no place to upload them

review.name: Quality

review.name: Solid piece
review.reviewBody: Product is well made and engineered to last

review.name: Very solid
review.reviewBody: The Alex was easier to put together than the ones we got 15+ years ago. They are solid and sturdy. It fits in well with our IKEA desktop. Our only concern is how easy the finish scratches.

review.name: Tight drawers
review.reviewBody: It’s cute. I feel like it’s overpriced a bit. But.. that’s what my daughter  wanted. But must indicate these drawers are hard to open and close. They feel very tight ! Wish they rolled easily.

review.name: Can't replace drawer slides
review.reviewBody: The drawer system is nice but cheap as is most of IKEA furniture. We recently had one of the drawer slides break and IKEA does not replace this part, which is ridiculous since you can take the part off the inner wall yourself with no issue. You can go on a wild goose chase and hope the store has a random extra part , but of course when we went they don't and we will have to buy a whole new unit. I am absolutely disappointed at  the ridiculousness of the quality of the furniture and what you have to go through to get a new part.

review.name: Art Supply Storage
review.reviewBody:
We needed a way to store the larger items for artwork such as canvases, drawing supplies, clean-up materials and similar. 

We may want to add casters. It wasn't obvious when we selected this unit that casters were an option.

review.name: Not great for young children
review.reviewBody: This cabinet is stylish and functional. The problem was that when kids used it they stuffed the drawers and it was very difficult to retrieve what was stuck in there. I couldn’t figure out how the drawers come out so I had to turn it upside down. It is rather heavy to have to do this often.

review.reviewBody: Directions were terrible. Instead of directions for one project they had directions for three. No specific instructions showing top from bottom. After I assembled unit I realized the top and bottom were assembled incorrectly. At this point after 6 hrs I just flipped over the unit. Never had such difficulty before with IKEA assembly.

review.name: One of the better IKEA pieces
review.reviewBody: This is a classic for a reason. It swallows up a lot of stuff and is pretty inconspicuous under a desktop. I find the builds pretty easy, though IMO there is always one drawer, no matter how hard I try to tighten the screws, that sticks a little. But mostly it works well.
